measurement: Stand upright and locate the point midway between the lowest ribs and the top of the hip bone (iliac crest). Wrap a flexible measuring tape around the trunk at this level and take the measurement while standing naturally without sucking in your stomach. Measure on bare skin or over a thin layer of clothing. If between sizes, choose the larger size. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
